# Legacy EPP series that llm-d releases emitted before the llm_d_epp_* names. Names, types, HELP text, label

#
#   llm-d/llm-d-router @ 71f4f0999f95b96c49a9d0c4afbd18dfdb943c26 (v0.10.0)
#     pkg/epp/metrics/metrics.go                                            inference_objective_*, inference_pool_*,
#                                                                            inference_extension_*,
#                                                                            llm_d_inference_scheduler_datalayer_*
#     pkg/epp/metrics/collectors/inference_pool.go                          inference_pool_per_pod_queue_size
#     pkg/epp/framework/plugins/scheduling/profilehandler/disagg/metrics.go llm_d_inference_scheduler_disagg_*
#     pkg/epp/framework/plugins/requestcontrol/dataproducer/approximateprefix/metrics.go  prefix indexer
#     pkg/epp/framework/plugins/requestcontrol/dataproducer/predictedlatency/metrics.go   TTFT and TPOT
#     pkg/kvcache/metrics/collector.go                                      kvcache_*
#
# The GIE-origin names match kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api-inference-extension @
# 616745e99b44f7ef0650b40ed1475756282d7e1f (v1.3.0) pkg/epp/metrics/metrics.go. v0.10.0 also dual-emits the
# llm_d_epp_* twins; they are left out so this file reflects an EPP that only exposes the legacy names.
